issues.description: Field mismatch for Person.birthday: The problem statement UML and the template repository declare Person.birthday as java.time.LocalDate (client and server expect a LocalDate). In the solution repository the shared Person model declares the birthday field as String. The solution's client view (PersonScene) also uses LocalDate (birthdayPicker.getValue()) and assigns it via Person.setBirthday(LocalDate), which conflicts with the solution model's String type. This inconsistency between the shared model (String) and the UI / specification (LocalDate) will cause compilation errors and confuses students about the intended type for Person.birthday.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Person.birthday type consistent across all artifacts. Prefer using java.time.LocalDate in the shared Person model to match the problem statement UML and client code. Concretely: change the field declaration in src/common/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java to 'private LocalDate birthday;', update the getter and setter signatures to use LocalDate, and adjust any serialization/deserialization (e.g., Jackson configuration or default formats) if needed. Alternatively, if String is required, update all client code (PersonScene, PersonController) and the problem statement references to convert to/from String consistently — but aligning to LocalDate is the recommended fix.
